storyline.real: Hamilton wins from 14th on the grid: rain arrives late, the leader Vettel slides into the barriers, and Hamilton stays out under the safety car.

mastery.label: Win with a stint on the soft tyre

eras.briefing: Hockenheim, 2018. A hydraulics failure in qualifying leaves Hamilton 14th on the grid, while Vettel starts from pole. Rain will come in the second half of the race.
